additions.provenance: server_only authoring loader first requires an individual department_manager or hotel_manager development identity, then reads one exact authoring row by identity-derived hotel_id plus authoring_id and optional allowed status; active department codes are revalidated and department_manager is restricted to its operational department

server_only append-only audit event insert uses identity-derived hotel_id, exact authoring_id and actor staff_user_id; composite same-hotel foreign keys prevent cross-tenant authoring or actor references

server_only draft creation requires individual Manager identity, validates every requested active department inside the identity hotel and restricts department_manager to exactly its own operational department before inserting hotel-owned source metadata

server_only source-text update first loads the exact same-hotel draft through Manager scope checks, then updates only that hotel_id+authoring_id while status remains draft; audit event stores source hash and length

server_only structured proposal save first loads same-hotel Manager-scoped authoring, then normalizes proposal while forcibly preserving stored standard_key and department_codes; update is constrained by identity hotel_id+authoring_id and draft/proposal_ready status

server_only document finalization follows Manager-scoped same-hotel authoring lookup, verifies expected tenant storage path, declaration, magic bytes and SHA256, then inserts immutable source metadata with composite same-hotel authoring and uploader foreign keys

server_only TXT source import updates source_text only for the exact identity hotel_id+authoring_id and only while draft; PDF/DOCX remain immutable private source documents and do not alter the proposal automatically

server_only authoring list requires individual Manager identity and reads only identity-derived hotel_id; department_manager results are additionally filtered to exactly its operational department while hotel_manager can view the hotel

server_only source-document listing first loads and authorizes exact same-hotel authoring, then selects documents by identity hotel_id plus that authoring_id and returns short-lived signed URLs from a private bucket

server_only human publish preparation reads only the latest revision number for identity-derived hotel_id plus the exact stored standard_key after same-hotel Manager-scoped proposal_ready authoring validation; DB publish RPC rechecks the expected next revision under an advisory lock

server_only service_role_only human publish authority; database locks same-hotel proposal_ready authoring, checks exact proposal hash, active identified manager and department scope, compares published Standard content to the stored structured proposal excluding only revision/status/hash fields, verifies next revision plus Training Plan lineage, then atomically inserts immutable published Standard and Training Plan and records approval/publication audit state
